item.title: Greece to Propose Landmark Postal Voting Extension for Diaspora in National Elections
item.description: Greek Interior Minister Thodoris Livanios announced plans to introduce landmark legislation in 2026 that would expand the use of postal voting to include Greeks living abroad in national elections, removing significant barriers to participation. item.title: Greece Braces for Public Sector Strike Amid Solidarity with Farmers' Protests
